notes: 300 MB is decimal and applies to all CopyPaste processes combined. Windows private commit is a conservative retained-memory guard; collect private working set and GPU/shared attribution separately.
Platform metric adapters must be validated on each supported OS; unlike metrics cannot be compared as the same physical RAM value.
Null thresholds are unresolved, never passing. Implementation cache limits are allocation controls, not measured release budgets.
Subsecond peaks require suitable native tracing beyond low-rate samples. Offline receipts do not replace trusted release provenance.

Feature budgets cover the paste queue, snippets, transforms, content rules and Android quick access. Every threshold is null: unresolved, never passing. check-resource-receipts.py does not read this object.
"all" means macOS, Windows and Android. Each measurement records the application, daemon or runtime, and workers separately and combined.
Spec proposals, not budgets: rules_capture_evaluation_ms 50 ms, snippets_render_64k_ms 50 ms. paste_queue_idle_wakeups_per_hour is compared with the feature disabled (paste-queue AC31).
binary_size_delta_bytes covers ICU4X compiled data, the bundled Windows tzdb and the YAML parser in the daemon, CLI and Android library.
Optimization registry entries RUN-107 to RUN-122 (except RUN-115, which moved with AI tools to the planned optional module) describe the behavior each key measures.
